memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: If a prophet, or one who foretells by dreams, appears among you and announces to you a sign or wonder, and if the sign or wonder spoken of takes place, and the prophet says, "Let us follow other gods" (gods you have not known) "and let us worship them," you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. The Lord your God is testing you to find out whether you love him with all your heart and with all your soul. - Deut 13:1-3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God gives Israel a striking test of discernment. What if a prophet arises, performs a genuine sign or wonder that actually comes true, but then uses it to lead people toward other gods? God's answer is clear: "you must not listen." Even a real miracle does not validate a message that draws people away from the true God. Truth is not determined by spectacle. If a teaching leads away from God and His word, no sign, however impressive, makes it right.

This is profoundly relevant. We can be dazzled by the miraculous, the charismatic, the powerful, and assume that impressive results must mean God's approval. But God warns that signs and wonders can accompany falsehood. The real test is not "Is it impressive?" but "Does it lead me toward the true God or away from Him?" Content matters more than spectacle.

Jesus warned that "false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive" (Matt 24:24). And so we are called to discernment, testing everything against God's revealed word. The measure of any teaching is whether it aligns with Scripture and points us to the God revealed in Christ. Notice too that God calls this a test of love — "whether you love him with all your heart." Our loyalty to God is proven when we refuse to be led astray, even by the impressive. Anchor yourself in God's word, love Him wholeheartedly, and let no spectacle pull you from the truth.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Am I ever dazzled by the impressive rather than testing it against God's word?
- How do I discern whether a teaching leads me toward God or away from Him?
- Does my loyalty to God hold firm even when falsehood looks impressive?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, guard me from being dazzled by spectacle that leads away from You. Give me discernment to test everything against Your word, and a heart so devoted to You that no impressive falsehood can pull me from the truth. Keep me loving You wholeheartedly. Amen.
